quotes.speaker: Toni Kukoč
quotes.summary_phrase: Toni Kukoč on Mario Hezonja's development and potential
quotes.excerpt: Mario Hezonja has experience now, he has too much experience. He is an athletic dominant player.
quotes.quote: Mario Hezonja has experience now, he has too much experience. He was there for the first time, he has experience from the EuroLeague and everything, and now he is returning there. His game has always been dear to me. I have always said that he should be one of the carriers of our basketball, because he is simply athletically dominant and he can hit. In the end, when you get into those crunch-time attacks before the end of the game, you can give him the ball and he will do something, something that is called chemistry, better than anyone else in my opinion.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Mario Hezonja ima iskustva sad, ima i previše iskustva. On je atletski dominantan igrač. Njegova igra je meni uvijek bila draga. Ja sam uvijek govorio da on treba biti jedan od nositelja naše košarke, jer on je jednostavno atletski dominantan i on može pogoditi. Uostalom, kad dođeš u one krizne napade pred kraj utakmice, možeš mu dati balun i on će nešto, ono što se kaže iskemijat, bolje nego iko drugi po mome mišljenju.

quotes.speaker: Toni Kukoč
quotes.summary_phrase: Toni Kukoč on the importance of high-level competition for player growth
quotes.excerpt: When you play something, when you play some big, important games, when you play at the highest level, then those players grow.
quotes.quote: When you play something, when you play some big, important games, when you play at the highest level, then those players grow, and they are also eager to reach a certain level, to reach some success and that. But when you play against someone who is not at that level, then it is difficult to grow. That is why I say that competition is the problem. When you play something, when you play some big, important games, when you play at the highest level, then those players grow.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Kad igraš nešto, kad igraš neke velike, važne utakmice, kad igraš na najvišem nivou, onda ti igrači rastu, i oni su isto željni doći do nekog nivoa, doći do nekog uspjeha i to. Ali kad igraš protiv nekoga ko nije na tom nivou, onda je teško rasti. Zato ja kažem da je problem kompetencija. Kad igraš nešto, kad igraš neke velike, važne utakmice, kad igraš na najvišem nivou, onda ti igrači rastu.

quotes.speaker: Toni Kukoč
quotes.summary_phrase: Toni Kukoč on the importance of body language and team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: When you hit a shot, you smile, you run, you are willing to help, you are willing to throw, you are willing to jump.
quotes.quote: When you hit a shot, you smile, you run, you are willing to help, you are willing to throw, you are willing to jump, you are willing not to shoot the ball because you believe instead of adding another shot. You want to do everything right. When you miss, you get frustrated, you get angry, you get down, and then everyone is angry. That is body language. Everyone knows that. When you hit a shot, you smile, you run, you are willing to help, you are willing to throw, you are willing to jump.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Kad ti pogodiš šut, nasmijan si, trčiš, voljan pomoć, voljan bacit, voljan skočit, voljan ne šutnit balun jer vjeruješ umjesto dodat još jedan šut. Želiš sve napravit kako treba. Kad promašiš, frustriran si, ljutiš se, padneš, i onda su svi ljuti. To je body language. Svi to znaju. Kad ti pogodiš šut, nasmijan si, trčiš, voljan pomoć, voljan bacit, voljan skočit.

quotes.speaker: Toni Kukoč
quotes.summary_phrase: Toni Kukoč on the difficulty of predicting the next Croatian NBA champion
quotes.excerpt: Don't ask me about Hajduk, don't ask me about that. I don't know who will be the champion.
quotes.quote: Don't ask me about Hajduk, don't ask me about that. I don't know who will be the champion. I don't know who will be the champion, I don't know who will be the champion, I don't know who will be the champion. I just know that I am the one who is the champion.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: A nemoj me Hajduka, nemoj me Hajduka spominjat. Ne znam ko će bit prvak. Ne znam ko će bit prvak, ne znam ko će bit prvak, ne znam ko će bit prvak. Ja samo znam da sam ja onaj koji je prvak.
